testcase.name: Scenario: Import settings while another command is staged on the same target: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:1525:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Import settings while another command is staged on the same target ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Tools ribbon visible ✔ And ribbon customization shows 2D Sketches applied to the Part Tools target ✔ And a settings file contains 2D Sketches on Part Tools with Large and Text unchecked ✔ And 3D Annotations is staged after 2D Sketches on Part Tools but has not been applied ✔ When the user imports the settings file ✔ Then the import chooser closes ✔ And the Part Tools target shows only 2D Sketches with Large and Text unchecked ✔ And 3D Annotations is available in the source list ✔ And the Part Tools target shows a pending-change marker ✔ And Apply and cancels are available ✔ When the user clicks Cancel in the customization dialog ✔ Then the customization dialog closes ✔ And the Tools ribbon remains visible
